use default

class SQUARE(letters: string) is
    row(c: char) -> int => letters.index_of(c) / 5 + 1
    col(c: char) -> int => letters.index_of(c) % 5 + 1
    at(r: int, c: int) -> char => letters[(r - 1) * 5 + (c - 1)]
si

normalize(text: string) -> string =>
    text.to_upper()
        |> filter(ch => ch >= 'A' /\ ch <= 'Z')
        |> map(ch => if ch == 'J' then 'I' else ch fi)
        |> map(ch => "{ch}")
        |> join("")

encrypt(text: string, square: SQUARE) -> string is
    let letters = normalize(text)
    let n = letters.length
    let rows = letters |> map(square.row)
    let cols = letters |> map(square.col)
    let coords = rows |> cat(cols) |> collect_list()

    let sb = System.Text.StringBuilder()

    for i in 0..n do
        sb.append(square.at(coords[i * 2], coords[i * 2 + 1]))
    od

    sb.to_string()
si

decrypt(text: string, square: SQUARE) -> string is
    let letters = normalize(text)
    let n = letters.length
    let coords = letters
        |> flat_map(ch => [square.row(ch), square.col(ch)])
        |> collect_list()

    let sb = System.Text.StringBuilder()

    for i in 0..n do
        sb.append(square.at(coords[i], coords[n + i]))
    od

    sb.to_string()
si

demo(label: string, message: string, square: SQUARE) is
    let encoded = encrypt(message, square)
    let decoded = decrypt(encoded, square)

    write_line(label)
    write_line("  plain:   {normalize(message)}")
    write_line("  encoded: {encoded}")
    write_line("  decoded: {decoded}")
si

let archetype = SQUARE("ABCDEFGHIKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ")
let wiki_square = SQUARE("BGWKZQPNDSIOAXEFCLUMTHYVR")

demo("archetypal square, task's own example", "ATTACKATDAWN", archetype)
demo("Wikipedia square, Wikipedia's own example", "FLEEATONCE", wiki_square)
demo(
    "task's example message, Wikipedia's square",
    "ATTACKATDAWN",
    wiki_square
)
demo(
    "longer message, archetypal square",
    "The invasion will start on the first of January",
